decision: Run lifecycle snapshots in a separate process while held-report heaptrack captures. Both measure allocation accounting/lifetime, not native latency. Each process has its own allocator/TLS state, 8-GiB address-space limit and600-second external timeout.
limits: Process RSS and payload accounting are separate from system-wide memory pressure; no timing benefit or latency comparison can be inferred. Any timeout must retain the concurrent-context limitation. Future native performance measurements will run without other task-owned heavy work.
